messages:
Mara: heads up — supplier pushed ETA for batch #8 from 2025-05-01 -> 2025-05-18. This wipes our staging window and will block h100 topoff next week. attaching AWB/manifest snippet below. need decision on expedite air vs re-route to crossdock.

Josh: can you post qty + delta cost? rough numbers will help finance signoff.

Mara: 12 H100 units, normal sea arrival cost USD 0, expedited air add ~18k (total) and shortens to 2025-05-05. if we re-route crossdock we risk customs hold + 3–5 days.

Lia: FYI this impacts dedicated-pool eu-west-1 capacity next week — we’ll lose ~120k tokens equivalent for the SLA window. open to temporary borrow from reserved pool?

supply-bot: [automated] Shipment 3PL-98765 changed ETA. Tags: #batch8 #H100 #impacting-staging. Notifying teams: eng-sre, procurement, ops.

Ryan (ops): my preference is expedite air for at most half the batch (6 units) to keep topoff partial; consolidate the remaining 6 into RMA-safe crates and hold at crossdock. reduces cost and keeps service.

Sam (customs): if we try air we need HS-code reclass + paperwork pre-filed. otherwise customs may hold for inspection — add 48–72h unpredictability. Anna, can carrier pre-clear for expedited?

Anna (carrier): we can fast-track pre-clear for air with broker fee ~1.2k and docs lead-time 24h. carrier needs invoice + origin packing list by EOD. reroute to FRA gateway possible.

Josh: finance check — do we have an existing credit buffer for expedited shipping? otherwise need PO amendment + invoice delta approval.

Mara: procurement can absorb up to 10k internally, we need finance approval for the rest. propose: company covers 10k, procurement signoff for scheduling, request finance credit note for remaining ~8k.

Ryan (ops): also propose adding RMA-prep label set to the 6 held units so if any DOA we can process without extra depot trips. Note: label template "RMA-H100-v2" in ops repo.

Lia: ops, please run quick telemetry: what happens to customer latency if we only topoff 6 units? need numbers to prioritize customer-facing accounts.

Mara: pasted manifest snippet: 
```
AWB: 5X-12345678
Supplier: NorthEast Compute Ltd
SKU: H100-48GB x12
Batch: BATCH8
ETA_old: 2025-05-01
ETA_new: 2025-05-18
```

Sam (customs): If we reclass HS to 8471.50 we often avoid physical inspection in FRA — need supplier to sign commercial invoice w/ declared value match PO.

Anna (carrier): confirm can pre-clear if invoice follows Sam's notes. I can schedule air pickup 24–36h after docs. extra broker fee billed to Redwood.

Josh: tagging @finance (not in thread) — pls approve credit note up to $8k for expedited air + $1.2k broker fee. also need PO amendment process check.

Mara: summary / proposed action: 1) expedite air for 6 units to meet topoff window (estimated +9k share) 2) hold 6 units at FRA crossdock with RMA labels applied 3) procurement covers 10k, request finance credit for remaining delta 4) customs to pre-file HS-classification to minimize hold 5) ops to add telemetry ticket and run impact sim.

Ryan (ops): i’ll create ops ticket OPS-7823 to track telemetry + crate prep. will ping once numbers in.

Josh: +1 on plan. Mara please start PO amendment + supplier sign-off for commercial invoice. Finance please ack. :thumbsup: 

Sam (customs): :eyes: will draft pre-clear checklist and send to Anna + supplier contact.

Anna (carrier): booked broker hold tentatively, awaiting docs.

Mara: thanks — proceeding with vendor sign-off. if finance greenlights, we push air tomorrow. otherwise fallback is full crossdock with RMA consolidation.

supply-bot: [automated] Created ticket OPS-7823 and procurement PR-44821.

Lia: will post telemetry snapshot in OPS-7823 when ready.

Josh: finance ack pending, will update thread when approval done. :money_with_wings:
